data.title: 信浓 · 空音乐厅捡回一张节目单
data.description: 散场后的音乐厅只剩台边一排地灯。信浓沿着红绒座椅慢慢走，把夹在扶手与椅背之间的节目单抽了出来。她起身时，深紫丝绒鱼尾礼服下摆顺过台阶，银星项链借到一小块暖光。
data.location: 音乐厅侧过道与散场后的观众席
data.action: 弯身从座椅扶手旁抽出遗漏的节目单
data.lighting: 台边低矮引导灯照出紫丝绒和地面台阶，厅顶在暗处
data.camera: 观众席侧面全身，沿过道取纵深
data.promptProse: After the concert, Shinano stops by a row of velvet seats and draws a paper program out from beside an armrest. Her deep-purple strapless velvet evening gown trails along the aisle in a mermaid flare. A low aisle light catches the small silver star on her necklace as she straightens up.
data.animaCaption: The program comes loose between her fingers while the hem follows the line of the aisle steps.
